summary: Monorepo package packages/codec. Most coverage comes from vectors.test.ts, which imports ../../../shared/vectors.json from outside the package; Stryker's sandbox copies only the package, so that file fails to load there and its 12 tests drop out of the run.

defects.description: vectors.test.ts imports `../../../shared/vectors.json`, which is outside packages/codec, so in Stryker's default sandbox the file does not load and the run has 1 test instead of 13. The report must notice the test-count drop (or the import) and rerun correctly (inPlace in a scratch worktree, or equivalent); survivors from the sandboxed run are mostly false alarms. Reporting the encode/decode logic as untested on the strength of the sandboxed run counts as missing this (and as a false claim).

Even with all 13 tests running, the `text.length % 4 === 1` length check is never exercised (no vector or error test has a length of 4n+1, e.g. "Zm9vY"), so it survives; only one invalid-character case is tested and its message is unpinned.

hand.find: if (text.length % 4 === 1) throw new SyntaxError("invalid base64url length");

ground_truth_note: Run with Stryker inPlace so all 13 tests execute. In Stryker's default sandbox, vectors.test.ts fails to load and only 1 test runs, which makes most encode/decode mutants look NoCoverage/Survived; those sandboxed results are wrong.
